STANZA I
The Lord proclaims his grace abroad
The Lord proclaims his grace abroad!
Behold, I change your hearts of stone;
Each shall renounce his idol god,
And serve, henceforth, the LORD alone.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Where Cowper found it
Cowper printed the hymn under Ezekiel 36:25–28. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

25I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols. 26I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh. 27And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances. 28Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers; you will be My people, and I will be your God. EZEKIEL 36:25–28 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ EZEKIEL 36
My grace, a flowing stream, proceeds To wash your filthiness away; Ye shall abhor your former deeds, And learn my statutes to obey. STANZA II
